title: Quenched Fluffy Middle Eastern Pilchards Kibbeh
description: A nutty and fluffy Middle Eastern dish featuring pilchards, perfect for a hangover cure, made with ayurvedic-sattvic friendly ingredients and grilled to perfection in a yakimono style, served in a lotus leaf wrap.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked bulgur wheat, flaked pilchards, chopped onion, minced garlic, chopped pine nuts, spices, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small oval shapes, about 1 1/2 inches long and 1 inch wide.
Wrap each kibbeh in a lotus leaf, making sure to seal the edges well.
Brush the yakimono grill with a small amount of oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kibbeh for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Serve the quenched fluffy Middle Eastern pilchards kibbeh hot, garnished with additional pine nuts and spices if desired.
Repeat with the remaining kibbeh and lotus leaves.
